reviews.text: We had a great experience with PA Chimney Pros. Shawn and Will installed a chimney liner and built this custom stone fireplace wall, they also changed out our former insert. The workmanship is top-notch.
reviews.author: Shaylynn R.

reviews.text: Called to schedule work on my fireplace - PA Chimney Pros came the same day, were able to offer safe alternatives for my fireplace, and work was done quickly. Now I can enjoy my fireplace and ensure my house stays safe.
reviews.author: Sterling

reviews.text: They did a fantastic job! I had a very large area of brick I wanted them to "schmear" which is basically putting a light coat of plaster randomly over the brick to give it somewhat rustic old world look. It turned out beautifully!
reviews.author: Dianne H.
